body:
# Survivor Beacon

### <font color="cyan">1.26+ | Paper, Spigot, Bukkit</font>

## About

This plugin is perfect for Survival Servers, PvP Servers, Hardcore Servers, Events & Minigames. Simple, lightweight, and easy to use.

Place a beacon to claim it as your own, set your respawn point, customize its appearance, and track nearby players with a Hunter Compass.

![Screenshot of Survivor Beacon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ecee18b5311bd6c070fd858b6a90865d7598b8d.png)

## Compasses

Hunter Compass - Tracks the nearest player in a 100 block radius.

Beacon Tracker Compass - Tracks a player's beacon nearby.

![Image of a Compass](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09890df1afdb6b29cde5029db1ccb6fd8f852fbc.gif)   ![Screenshot of Recovery Compass](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ff5904d5bce807dfdcd6b7b6dd6ec1e239ddace.gif)

## Features

* When a player's beacon is destroyed, they lose the ability to respawn.
* Admin can choose what happens after a beacon is destroyed:

  * Spectator Mode
  * Kick Player
  * Respawn at a custom location
  * Teleport to a specific entity or player
* Once player has the Survivor Beacon, they can't throw it out.
* Custom sign colors
* Custom sign types
* Beacon particle and sound effects
* Hunter Compass to track nearby players
* Survivor Beacon Tracker Compass to track nearby beacons
* Beacon protection system
* Easy-to-use GUI menus
* Admin beacon management

## Important

<font color="yellow">**IF THE COMMANDS DO NOT WORK, REMOVE THE PLUGIN (Survivor Beacon) FROM YOUR SERVER, REJOIN YOUR SERVER AND THEN TAG YOURSELF "owner" AND "admin" (NO CAPITAL LETTERS), THEN ADD THE PLUGIN BACK TO YOUR SERVER.**</font>

## Permissions

Tag yourself "admin" to access admin commands.

### /tag @s add admin

## Commands

<font color="red">**(Only players tagged "admin" can use HXS custom commands)**</font>

/hxs givebeacon - Gives yourself a Survivor Beacon.

/hxs compass - Gives you a Hunter Compass (detects the nearest player within a 100 block radius).

/hxs help - Lists all custom commands.

(Not all custom commands are shown above.)
